items.title: From chaos to 'intelligent' soft matter—how tiny chemical differences guide droplets into ordered structures
items.abstract: Disorder can make sense, and understanding its logic can be genuinely useful. A study by a research group at the University of Trento shows how a minimal chemical difference can turn chaotic, disordered motion into a highly coordinated and reproducible structure.
